environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate, connecting to PostgreSQL 15 on RDS. The database user configured in application.yml (spring.datasource.username=app_secrets_rw) has been granted ALL PRIVILEGES on the secrets table. The service is exposed via an internal ALB with no request filtering. AES ECB mode with hardcoded key is used for all encryption operations.

config.database_grants: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE secrets TO app_secrets_rw
